title: role -- the cell role manifest (the depth dial over ONE field space)
$comment: Generated mirror of contracts/role.md v5.1.0 (P3 resolution) -- the .md is the source of truth; regenerate on any bump (CONTRACT-HDR-1).
description: Root = the role manifest field space (role.md sec 1, complete). Validation is STRICT at authoring/spawn time (unknown fields refused with a typed error -- a typo'd knob must not silently no-op; template R5/L-STRICT-SPAWN) and LIBERAL for every other consumer (unknown fields preserved) -- this mirror models the STRICT operator-boundary shape, hence additionalProperties false throughout. Only `name` is REQUIRED. Defaults [R28]: sec 2 is the table of depth-VARYING defaults keyed by `depth`; depth-INVARIANT fields (comment, prompt, egress, oracle_ref, diversity, max_wager_horizon) carry their default in sec 1 and are deliberately absent from sec 2 (no JSON defaults are baked here for depth-varying fields). standing_access [LB4] and max_wager_horizon [R29] joined the field space in 5.1.0.

name.$comment: REQUIRED. The only field with no default

depth.$comment: selects the DEFAULTS COLUMN (sec 2), nothing else; runtime never branches on depth except the preset loader (L-NO-DEPTH-BRANCH)

comment.$comment: free text; never enters the frame

provider.$comment: WEIGHTS = the diversity axis; the role PINS it (blind spots follow weights, not endpoints -- F1/F9). Depth is orthogonal to intelligence

effort.$comment: provider effort dial, if the lane has one

lane_hints.$comment: HINTS ONLY -- the economics plane may override, logged

prompt.$comment: the role's system prompt (frame S0 head; positive specification)

grounding_mode.$comment: the A11 dial -- act.md 9.1 owns the mode semantics (cite-or-abstain is not a legal value; canon #8); a run may RAISE, never lower (L-RAISE-ONLY)

profile.$comment: TOOL-PROFILE ANNEX id (act.md sec 10 format; carries harm floor, egress allowlist, credential_carrier, trifecta booleans -- declared values are ADVISORY; identity-firewall.md B.4's Rule-of-Two gate RECOMPUTES the fold at spawn and at every ingress, refusing a profile whose declaration is weaker than the recomputation). profile null is REFUSED at spawn for harm >= H1 tools

anyOf.$comment: a bare-string entry is read as {ref: s, profile: null} (reader liberality)

tools.$comment: identity-firewall.md B.4's Rule-of-Two gate recomputes the trifecta fold at spawn and at every ingress; declared profile trifecta{} is ADVISORY

harm_ceiling.$comment: the membrane gate enforces; a run may LOWER, never raise (L-RAISE-ONLY)

egress.$comment: DECLARATION of intended hosts; enforcement = identity-firewall.md; depth-invariant (R28)

standing_access.$comment: LB4: declared private-surface access the role may read (closed set). Depth defaults (sec 2): d0/d1 = []; d2/d3 per role. The trifecta private_data leg reads it -- act.md 6.1h at the act gate; identity-firewall.md B.4 folds it with received peer output and operator-memory grants

diversity.$comment: bound by the run manifest's diversity vector (run.md R1 roster)

seed.$comment: null, or the bound seed value

max_wager_horizon.$comment: R29: depth-INVARIANT (default 7d; marked in sec 1, absent from sec 2 per R28). The furthest future a held act may be wagered against; act.md sec 4 reads it and sec 13 promises it -- relocated here in the P3 pass

memory.$comment: every knob's mechanism lives in contracts/nucleus.md 5.0

ledger.$comment: none legal at ANY depth -- sealed-set grader cells use it so sealed bytes can never land in a nucleus record (L-SEALED-SET, trust seam)

fsync.$comment: gold = the two laws + group-commit; always = exact v1 fsync-every-append behavior

cold_eyes_family.$comment: rotate (default; != L1, rotates per pass) | a pinned family != L1

install.$comment: task-boundary -- never mid-task (the cache seam depends on it)

frame.$comment: assembler knobs (nucleus.md sec 7); ratio defaults per depth live in role.md sec 2 -- one table, not duplicated

ratios.$comment: S0+S1+S2 ratio-budget overflow at the declared window is REFUSED at spawn (L-STRICT-SPAWN; nucleus.md 7.2 step 5 hysteresis)

salience.$comment: weights feed SALIENCE_v1 (nucleus.md 7.3); a weight change bumps salience/1.x in every subsequent manifest

self_tune.$comment: d3: journaled tuning, +/- bounds, never beyond

anchor.$comment: d3: post ledger head hash to Medium (compiles to a status post -- no new wire type)

role_digest_law.$comment: L-ROLE-DIGEST (role.md sec 4): role_digest = sha256(canon(manifest AFTER defaults expansion)), recorded in the nucleus genesis; frame determinism and cache epochs key on it. Editing a role mid-life is a NEW digest -- a re-manifest event, never silent drift. (Documentation def; not referenced.)
